## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Test Your Knowledge

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Impairment corrodes judgment, never quickening reactions or sharpening focus [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Your-side dashes open your side alone, never both directions [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
Twin four-way arrivals yield right, never plowing through or bowing left [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A01
Regulatory boards wear white, against warning yellow and guide green [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A01
Jaywalkers command stops, never horns or dismissals [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A01
Motorcycles own whole lanes, never shares or shoulders [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F08 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A01
Cyclists earn slow room, never honks or hurried squeezes [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A01
Highs serve empty roads, while storms and followers take lows [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A01
Eleven rehearsal items plus a letter key preview the exam without being it [A01].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F01, sec12-F12 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A02
Distraction research credits research bodies, while the imprint frames a 2022 rules supplement [A02].
Why it matters: group sample-test; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F13, sec12-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0081]
